notes: invest_private sweep, run 2026-08-24 within caps (18 searches, 12 WebFetch; Google News redirectors decoded via batchexecute in Bash and publisher pages curled, so several sources have full-text backing beyond the caps). STRUCTURE OF THE STORY: (1) Totals/concentration — record $510B H1 2026 global VC, AI ~80% of Q1 2026 funding, OpenAI+Anthropic = 43% of H1; boom is US-centric (Crunchbase 'not a global phenomenon', Jun 15 2026, per headline).
